# ComproGear

> ComproGear specializes in medical-grade compression socks and stockings for venous health, leg pain relief, and therapeutic treatment of conditions like DVT and chronic venous insufficiency.

ComproGear offers a comprehensive range of compression hosiery products with detailed guides on sizing, selection, and medical applications. The site serves customers seeking graduated compression solutions (20-30 mmHg) for various leg health conditions, with specialized options for wide calf fits and elderly users.
